subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped Claw v1 CLI and manifest contract now, and must each installed Claw have an immutable install identity independent of its local agent id?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but merging makes the first durable implementation commitment for a still-draft multi-owner lifecycle whose identity choice affects provenance, update, remove, export, and every dependent PR.

options.title: Approve identity contract first
options.body: Pause landing until the RFC explicitly settles immutable install identity and maintainers accept the resulting CLI, schema, provenance, and upgrade contract.

options.title: Merge as breakable incubation
options.body: Land the environment-gated slice now while explicitly accepting that its experimental schemas and downstream stack may require breaking revision.

options.title: Narrow the incubation surface
options.body: Keep only internal schema and planning primitives until the user-visible CLI and lifecycle identity have product approval.

recommendation.title: Approve identity contract first
recommendation.body: Pause landing until the RFC explicitly settles immutable install identity and maintainers accept the resulting CLI, schema, provenance, and upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the product-model revision that defines this implementation and has already performed the deepest contract-level review of this slice.
